office_reference.destination_rule: office_site hash first; city/country fallback only when office_site is not in the catalog; nearest candidate office used when a city has multiple records

residential_reference.dataset: GeoNames postal-code coordinates mirrored by symerio

method.distance: Haversine distance between residential postal centroid and Qualcomm office coordinate
method.binning: floor(distance_km) into one-kilometre intervals before privacy coalescing
method.interpretation: Geographic approximation; not route distance, travel time, or actual commute
method.residential_zip_handling: postal_code queried as MD5 hash and never written to the artifact

acceptance_rule: Las bandas de distancia suman la población cubierta; el remanente se reporta como No calculable; cada categoría visible tiene n>=30; no se imputan ZIPs ni oficinas sin match.
